segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Distinguished colleagues, former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I hope you're already proud seeing your former SK chair

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: or president leading this hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Members of the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Officials of the Department of Urban Settlement and Urban

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Development, headed by, of course, Secretary Ping Aliling,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and its attached agencies and corporations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: our resource persons, distinguished guests,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Maayong hapon sa aton tanan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Today's budget briefing gives the committee an opportunity

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to assess the department's performance

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: under the fiscal year 2026 budget, review the implementation

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: of its major programs, and determine whether the proposal

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: or the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget is adequate

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and responsive to the country's continuing housing needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: We recognize the progress achieved under the expanded

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Pabansang-Pabahay para sa Pilipino, or 4PH program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: particularly the adoption

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: of more flexible housing modalities and the mobilization of private sector participation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Stronger coordination with LGUs and other national government agencies is likewise essential

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to translating these initiatives into affordable and sustainable housing options for Filipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: At the same time, serious challenges remain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: These include the substantial housing deficit, limited access to suitable land and affordable

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: housing or financing, permitting and implementation delays, and the need to ensure the approved

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: projects are funded, completed, and turned over to qualified beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: The committee is particularly concerned about the persistent gap between the national housing

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: requirements and the department's current delivery targets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the proposed budget must provide clear and concrete responses

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to these challenges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Under the fiscal year 2027 NEP, DHSUD and its attached agencies and corporations are allocated a combined ₱5.498 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And this ₱579.55 million, or about 9.5%, below ₱6.78 billion provided under the 2026 fiscal year GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And ₱54.52 billion, or ₱5.2 billion lower than the agency's aggregate ₱60 billion budget proposal. Of the net amount, ₱2.492 billion is allocated to DHSUD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: ₱2.274 billion to NHA, ₱566 million to HSAC, ₱1.66 million to SHFC, and ₱450,000 to NHFC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Given these differences, the Committee will closely examine fiscal year 2026 fund utilization and accomplishment, the implementation status of ongoing 4PH projects, the causes of delays or underspending, and the measures proposed to accelerate housing delivery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Above all, every peso appropriated for housing must translate

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: into measurable results, more completed and occupied units, broader access to affordable housing, and safer and more dignified living conditions for Filipino families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: We look forward once again to focus on constructive discussion with DHSUD and its attached agencies and corporations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And with this, we now invite the department to proceed with its presentation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Maraming salamat sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Secretary Aliling, you can...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chairperson Jam Baronda, former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, members of this committee, Chairperson Marie V. Copilar of the Housing Committee.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Lahat po nung nandito ngayon, magandang umaga.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Nandito po kami ngayon para i-present sa inyo, unang-una ano ba yung mga ating mga na-accomplish itong nakaraan taon

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: at ano yung mga

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: kakailanganin po natin sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pagdating po sa pag-address ng housing need na based po sa PSA

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ay 3.7 million, 3.7 million po, hindi po 6.9 million hanggang 2028.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Isa po sa mga highlights ng aming presentation ay mag-aapila po kami

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: na paano po natin paparamihin yung iba nating mga programa sa pabahay.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Dahil po ang 3.7 million na housing needs by 2028, hindi po ibig sabihin yan kailangan natin gumawa ng 3.7 million na bahay.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Dahil ang 3.7 million po na yan na sinasabi ng PSA na magiging housing needs natin by 2028, nakahati po yan sa tatlong kategories.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Number one, ito po, meron po mga kasalukuyang may bahay ngayon, ngunit kailangan na ayusin.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So ang kailangan po niyan, hindi po bahay at lupa na bago.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang kailangan po niyan, unang-una,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: mapag-andar natin na mas mabilis ang community mortgage program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: At pag paandar po natin ang community mortgage program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: in-expand po natin yung CMP

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: para mapaayos po nila

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang kanilang mga tahanan.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So yung 1.1 million po na yan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang solusyon dyan CMP and then yung in-expand po natin ang programa ng SHFC

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: pati na po yung pampagawa ng bahay

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: at utilities nila.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Kunyari binabaha, kailangan na mga ayusin yung mga site development, kasama na po dyan.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Then, nandyan din po sa solusyon sa number one category na yan

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ay ang home improvement loan ng Pag-IBIG Fund.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pangalawang kategorya po, ito po ang tinatawag nating mga double up.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ano po ba itong double up?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang double up po, ito po yung may mga bahay na mas marami sa isang pamilya ang nakatira.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, ang hinahighlight lang po natin sa pangalawang kategorya na ito,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: hindi po ito nalilimit sa informal settler families.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Lahat po, yung buong spektrum po ng housing, sinasabi ko nga para maintindihan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: mula sa ISF areas hanggang sa Forbes Park ang nakatira,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: kung more than one family po ang nakatira sa bahay na yun, kasama po dito sa numero na ito.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pangatlo, 1.1 million po ang projected ng PSA na magkakaroon ng sariling pamilya.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito po,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang kailangan nito kung mag-dedecision silang humiwalay sa kanilang mga present na pamilya, sa kanilang mga magulang,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: makangilangan po ito ng bahay.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pangatlo, dito po nagkaroon ng diferensya yung 6.9 million sa 3.7 million na housing needs.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Doon po sa 6.9 million, yung unang pong study,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang assumption po doon, yung inventory loss, ito yung may mga bahay ngayon na masisira

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: through wear and tear, bagyo, earthquake, etc.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Nakalagay po doon, 3.7 million ang projected na loss in inventory.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Dito po, sa 3.7 million na housing need na sinasabi ng PSA,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang sinasabi lang dito, kung meron pong masisirang 3.7 million, meron pong magpapagawa.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So pag binawas nyo po yung magpapagawa, ang sinasabi po ng latest na PSA na survey o study,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang magiging loss ng inventory lang is P399,000.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So yun lang po ang naging diferensya nung P6.9 million na unang sinasabi nating projected na housing needs by 2028

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: versus itong P3.7 million na latest na linabas po ng PSA.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So ito po, sinasabi lang namin, ang 4PH alone, hindi siya ang solusyon dito sa housing needs na 3.7.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Kasi tulad niya po na nasabi ko, kasama po dito yung formal communities.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So pati po yung gagawin ng mga bahay, ng mga private developers,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ito po kasama po ito sa magsasolve ng 3.7 million na housing backlog natin by 2028.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa regulatory, tayo po ay binabalansin natin ang interest ng mga developers at ng mga homebuyers.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So kung ito po mga nakarang araw, maririnig po natin o mababasa natin sa mga social media

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: na may mga umapila sa amin ang mga developers na nakahihirapan po kumuha ng mga license to sell.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So inayos po natin ito, basically 10 weeks na po

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ten weeks na po, consecutive weeks, ang DHS-UD na zero pending overdue sa regulatory applications.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang ibig pong sabihin nito, lahat po ng regulatory applications nitong nakaraang sampung linggo ay naaksyonan within 15 days.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: within 15 days, 1-5, 15 days.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ano po ba itong mga aksyon na ito?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Una-una, pwedeng ma-approve ang kanilang mga application.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pangalawa, pwedeng ma-deny.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pangatlo po, pwede po silang ma-issuehan ng Notice of Deficiencies.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pag sila po ay na-issuehan ng Notice of Deficiencies, meron po silang 90 days to comply.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ngayon, ang ginawa po natin para madalian po silang mag-comply,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: naglabas po tayo ng guidelines na bago na

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: they are allowed to apply for temporary license to sell

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: habang kinukumply po nila ang kanilang mga deficiencies.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So nito pong nakaraang dalawang buwan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ito pong July and towards the end of June, July and August,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: nakita po natin ang numero po na qualify or na-approve na mga license to sell ay tumaas po.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: In fact, yung numero po ng ating mga license to sell

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ating mga license to sell na na-approve or na-qualify for any kind of license to sell.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pwede po siyang regular license to sell, conditional license to sell, or temporary license to sell.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Makikita po natin, on the same period po ng last year, 2025, pareho na po halos ang ating numero ng 2025 and 2026.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa mga reklamo ng mga homebuyers,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Gina-action na rin po ng departamento ang mga reklamo nila through mass conciliations. Meron po tayong datos dyan na kung dati po, ang dinatnang po namin backlog no, nung ako yung naging na-appoint na sekretary

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang kailangan namin action na rin was 3,000.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So na-address na po namin yan.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Although tuloy-tuloy po yung pag-file ng mga reklamo ng mga homebuyers versus the developers

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Tuloy-tuloy po ang pagkakondak natin ng mga conciliations.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So ito na po ang DHSUD ngayon.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Sana po ito pong presentation namin, ito pong ina-appel na namin

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: na dagdag na pondo para sa mga housing programs po ng gobyerno ay inyong makonsider.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Magandang hapon po. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I would just like to request first, ComSec, to read the resource person from DBM.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: We would like to acknowledge our resource person, our guest from the DBM, headed by Director Benjelette Zuniga.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Thank you, ma'am.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Before we proceed with interpellators, I would like to remind our distinguished colleagues

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: that each member is given five minutes for questioning or interpellation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: excluding the response of the resource persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And when you hear the bell sound, it means you only have like 30 seconds

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to wind up with your questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So as part of our long-standing, repeated tradition of the House of Representatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: to accord preferential treatment to the minority of the House

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: and followed by the independent and the majority members in an alternating manner.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Can we present?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Ah, yes, nagpa-present pala.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: That was just the introduction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I, I thought we need to dispense the presentation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: We'll just proceed with the interpellation.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Although I mentioned the summary of the presentation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Okay, I would like to request once again,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Secretary and some other attached agencies to please proceed with your presentations.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Usec Henry will present.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Pero yun na rin yun.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Good afternoon, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Former President Gloria Magal-Arroyo, distinguished members of the House Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Today, our briefing focuses

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: on the Department, its key shelter agencies, and our various programs.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: As an outline, we would like to cover a very brief overview of the agency's mandate,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the proposed budget highlights for 2027, our accomplishments for the year 2025 and the targets,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: our performance, our budget utilization rate, as well as an additional request from our key shelter agencies.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: By way of background, our department is quite young.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: It's seven years old, but it is the primary national government agency or entity responsible for the management of housing,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: human settlements, and urban development.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The department is also the sole and main planning and policymaking, regulatory, program coordination,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and performance monitoring entity for all housing, human settlements, and urban development.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Our attached agencies can be categorized into three.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: First, for production with the National Housing Authority,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: financing with the Social Housing Finance Corporation,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the Pag-ibig Fund,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and the National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and our attached adjudication body, the Human Settlements Adjudication Commission, or HSAAC.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: To show you the highlights and major thrusts for 2027's proposed budget,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: I'd like to show you the comparison of the 2026 GAA, the 2027 NEP,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and the variance between the 2027 proposal of the DSUD and the key shelter agencies.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: For 2027 NEP, the total of 5.498 billion has been allocated.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In comparison, the amount is 579 million smaller than the 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast, however, the total proposed submission of DSUD and its key shelter agencies

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: totaled approximately 60 billion,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: or an eventual shortfall of 54 billion in the total amount being requested.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: For DSUD, the amount that is being allocated for next year is 2.492 billion.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast, the requested amount of DSUD for its various flagships,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: flagships, and regular programs amount to 4.962 billion.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: For the Human Settlements Adjudication Commission,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: a total amount of 566 million has been requested for 2027

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: against a proposed budget of 890 million.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The amount are being requested for HSAAC's resolution of cases and complaints

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: arising from the implementation of laws, rules, and regulations

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: related to zoning, subdivision and condominium developments,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: intra and inter homeowners association disputes, and appealed cases.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Our main production arm, the National Housing Authority,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: is being allocated 2.274 billion for 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast, it requested a budget of 44.732 billion.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The amount requested is to...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: ...to support resettlement programs for displaced families,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: kalami victims, indigenous peoples, including former rebels.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The Social Housing Finance Corporation, another financing agency,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: was being allocated the amount of 166 million for the 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast, it has requested a amount of 4.666 billion.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: It is the main arm agency in charge...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: ...with the Community Mortgage Program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: And in previous years, have also been involved in high-density housing programs

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: in providing support to DOTR and DPWH,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: as well as provide Marawi Shelter Program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation is being allocated 450,000.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Tama po yung kanina, 450,000.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast, the amount it is requesting is

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: P4.750 billion.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: And that amount will be used to purchase receivables of various tenors,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: as well as to be utilized for the securitization of its asset-backed securities.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Our last attached agency is the Home Development Mutual Fund.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: They are not asking for any budget,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: but we would like to highlight its contribution to the

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: value chain of housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: It basically addresses the housing needs by providing rental housing loan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: as mentioned by the Secretary,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Home Loan Program, GLAD Plus,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for acquisition, including the purchase of ROPA or repossessed assets.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In addition, since last year, it has brought down its affordable housing financing

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: by lowering the percentage...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: ...or the interest to 3% for socialized housing,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 4.5% for economic housing,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and 5.75% for open housing up to a maximum of 10 million pesos.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Let us now consider the accomplishments of the housing sector versus the target in 2025.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: As shown in the table, we have outlined the accomplishment during the administration of President Aquino.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Just to clarify, ito pong table na ito is just the government housing program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: So we do not expect these numbers, the 1.13, to address the 3.7 million backlog by 2028

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: because as I said a while ago, kasama po yung private sector production to address the backlog.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: So we have outlined here the accomplishments during the term of President Aquino,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: President Duterte, and the current administration divided into July 2022 to the present, or July 2026,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and then the balance from August 2026 to June of 2028.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: For the accomplishment for this administration,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: a total of 588,757 have been accomplished, direct and indirect units or assistance.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: A total of

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 544,000 is still to be undertaken with a target of 1.133 million by the end of this administration.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: As noted in the presentation of our Secretary,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: since his assumption, the 4PH has been expanded to allow more options to the Filipino families.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In contrast to the vertical housing that was previously undertaken,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: today home ownership can include horizontal housing,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the real and other property acquired or ROPA,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the provision of low-interest incentive programs by Pag-IBIG,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: as well as the high-density housing of the Social Housing Finance Corporation.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In terms of rental and transitional housing,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: new projects are being developed and have been started,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and also modular housing for emergency and temporary housing in disaster-stricken areas.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: As part of the revitalization program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the community-led housing through the enhanced community mortgage was revived last year,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: covering a period of...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to cover the hiatus of three years in the previous term, previous Secretary.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Today, we have also revitalized the presidential proclamation

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and non-socialized housing enrolled under expanded 4PH

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to add up to additional land and housing

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: supply mobilization.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The 2025 DSUD performance at a glance.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Let me now highlight some of the programs that are being undertaken by the Department.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: First is the Human Settlements and Urban Development Coordination Program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: where the DSUD was able to work with different government agencies

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: in improving or updating the National Resettlement Policy Framework,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the incorporation of emergency shelter support,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to affected families,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the cooperation between DSUD and the SWD

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for those graduating from the 4Ps to access 4PH,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and our partnership with the Department of Education

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to handle the housing requirements in resettlement areas.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: With the revitalization of the presidential proclamations,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: a total of 213 families have been awarded the Certificate of Entitlement.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: We have also implemented IDSAP,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: or the Integrated Disaster Shelter Assistance Program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and in 2025,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: we're able to fund or give benefits to about 16,700 partially damaged houses,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 6,550 totally damaged houses,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: at the amount of approximately 365 million.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: To date, all amount has been spent as of middle of the year.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In addition,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the DSUD also is mobilizing or has mobilized the National Drive

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: against professional squatters and squatting syndicates,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: with 39 cases being processed,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 12 capacity building among the various agencies,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and active local end-ups, cases of about 300.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: For our Homeowners Association and Community Development Program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the unit is principally in charge of

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: registering associations,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and to date,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: we have a total of 2,705 registered neighborhood homeowners association,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 23,698 regular homeowners association,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 238 federations,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and 35 confederations.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In addition,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the Bureau was able to deliver 100% or over 100% achievement

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: in its capacity building,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: while issuing various policies

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to enhance the protection of homeowners association.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In our Housing and Real Estate Development Regulations Commission,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: a total of 491 licenses to sell was issued last year,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: of which 418 covers residential and 73 non-residential.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Last year, towards end of November and early December,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the Department together with the DEB promulgated

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Joint Memo Circular Number 2025-001

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and its Implementing Rules and Regulations

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to adjust the price ceiling for socialized subdivision and condominium projects.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: With the Bureau of Internal Revenue also, a Revenue Circular No. 48-025 was issued by the Bureau to streamline the requirements for the application of Certificate of Tax Exemptions for Socialized Economic Housing pursuant to Republic Act 7279 and Executive Order 226.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Upon the prodding of the President and with the full support of the Secretary and the other agencies, late June, a Joint Memo Circular No. 1-026 was signed by 15 agencies to streamline the permitting system for housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: As shown, a number of processes and documentary requirements had been removed or will be removed as part of the streamlining process.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: And the overall processing time is expected to be reduced as much as 50%.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In the aspect of environmental land use and urban planning and development program, a total of 63.5% of our LGUs now have risk-informed plans.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: This number excludes the BARM as they are under the Department of Human Settlements and Development, which is outside the purview of our agency.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: A total of 153.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In 2023, LGUs were also trained and provided plan smart accounts, six pilot sites were identified for AutoCAM projects, and various LGUs have been provided CLUPs and PDP, a comprehensive land use plan and provincial development, physical development plan programs, subsidy studies in local shelter plant and other.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: We have also modernized our policies by the issuance of various guidelines.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: On planned unit development, resilient urban design development guidelines, transit-oriented development, and open space development programs.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Key planning tools and techniques have also been updated.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Two of the major digital initiatives last year of this program includes Plan Smart, which tries to automate the digitalization of risk-informed local plans.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: This is expected to reduce the planning cycle or review to less than one year from the previous two to three years.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In addition, we are now using digital remote sensing as well as geographic information system plus machine learning or AI to prepare our monitoring of compliance of land use and zoning.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: This is being undertaken through our AutoCAM project.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In highlighting our budget utilization, let me highlight the following summary.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The D-SUDE has a total current budget of 1.455 billion and a continuing budget of 1.497 for a total of 2,952 million.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Of this number, 1 billion has already been obligated or about a third has been obligated.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: While the obligation rate is 35%, the total disbursement rate is at 74%.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Excluding the amount for subsidy, the D-SUDE has actually exceeded the amount targeted for spending for the first half of this year.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: So our rough approximate is 100.4%.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: This covers all the various programs including the initiatives undertaken by other programs of the department.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: When we look at the comparative budget utilization from 2021 to 2025, for us to be to Apple to Apple, we've removed actually the interest subsidy which only came in 23 and 24.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: So we have an average allocation of...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Of which 86.82 overall obligation rate and a 95.37 overall disbursement rate.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Before we end, we'd like to mention that the D-SUDE has, under this administration, been able to receive three consecutive period of unmodified opinion from the department or from the commission on audit for the year 2023-2024.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Before we end, may we request the consideration of our committee to some of the additional budget requests being considered.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: The D-SUDE is proposing additional budget of 280 million to cover ISSP, the implementation and rollout of AutoCAM, the support to the Marawi Board based on Republic Act 11696,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the creation

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: of an anti-illegal real estate practice interagency task force

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and the second phase of the network of open green space

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and public parks projects.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In addition, we would like to support the request

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: of our attached agencies, AITSAC,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for 47 million to cover its COS personnel

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and motor vehicle procurement,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the NHA of 1.623 billion

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for its comprehensive and integrated housing program

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: covering danger areas and SC Mandamus,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: a amount of 2 billion for the Social Housing Finance Corporation

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for its enhanced community mortgage program,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and a amount of 8.08 billion broken down to 4.75 million

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for the receivables purchase

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and 3.33 billion

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: for the payment of NHMFC's SSS obligation.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: In conclusion, what does our 2027 budget entail

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: or will be able to do?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: One, it will be able to accelerate housing delivery

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and expand the pathways beyond the previous single modality.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Second, it will allow us to mobilize

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the whole of the housing finance system

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: including Pag-IBIG, the Social Housing Finance Corporation,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and NHMFC to multiply the effect of government funding.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: Three, improve the location and quality of settlements

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: by scaling up Planado and the risk-informed

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: comprehensive land use plans

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: while strengthening regulation and community governance,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: thus reducing processing backlogs

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and improve consumer and homeowners association services.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: And finally, the resolution of specific bottlenecks

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: responsible for consumer and home owners association services.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: We are also responsible for continuing appropriation

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: and closely monitoring our 2027 delivery.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: On that note, we appreciate the committee's continued support

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: in advancing the dignified housing and sustainable communities

segments.text: Noong 2025 po, ang taken-out units was only 1,000. Actually, yun yung 4PH na numbers noong 2025 before we expanded the program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ngayon po, nasa almost 130,000 yung inventory ng 4PH.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito po yung modality na binibili. Ito po yung vertical, mga condominium, and horizontal, yung mga house and lot na kasama po sa 4PH.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, makikita po natin, more than 120 times po ang in-increase ng production in terms of inventory ng 4PH.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ngayon, paano po ito mapapabilis?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: In-address po natin, tulad po ng sabi ko, ang ka-partner po natin dito sa Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino Program

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: are the private sector developers.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: who are developing socialized housing projects sa country.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, noong binuksan po natin yung 3%, na-address po natin dyan, yung 3% interest program po, 4PH interest program po yan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: subsidized interest po yan kasi 6.25 naging 3 ng pag-ibig fund, na-address po natin yung tinatawag natin demand side.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, mas marami na pong mga developers ngayon na nag-de-develop na po ng socialized housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Kasi, napakaganda po, nakita po nila, napakaganda po nung market na ito.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.text: mabilis po nabibenta yung mga socialized housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, in the next, ito pong taon na to, marami na po ang ongoing na construction ng socialized housing all over the country.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Marami na pong mga developers ang nag-inquire sa atin kung paano natin sila matutulungan.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, dun sila ngayon nagagawa, market driven na po ang 4PH ngayon.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.text: the streamlining po. Madam Chair, Mr. Congressman, we were able in June of this year, work out with ARTA the issuance of a Joint Memo Circular

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 001-2026. Ang objective po nung document na iyon is

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: to streamline the permitting. So if I may share what we have agreed with

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 15 other government agencies. For the subdivision housing permit, yung requirements po from 223, ibababa po namin to 62 or a

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 72% reduction in the requirements. As far

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: as the condominium projects, 162 requirements will be brought down to 71 which is a

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: 56% reduction in the requirements. In terms of timetable po, different din po, we also agreed at

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: three different stages of each of the processing, ibababa Abad din po namin ang requirements sa subdivision by as much as 76

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: percent and then sa

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: condominium as much as 75 percent. Once implemented,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Senior Undersecretary Henry L. Yap
segments.text: the total processing time will actually be reduced by 50 percent. Yun

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: po ang target namin with

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: the joint memo circular signed last June.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Okay, thank you

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Madam Chair. So,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: kailan yan siya ma-implement sir? More progressive po ito. We streamline continuously. Ang sinasabi lang natin, ang target natin, at the end of

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: the process, we will be able to

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: reduce the process by 50%. Hindi ba pwedeng yung sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: socialized housing, mas streamlined

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: pa siya kaysa commercial housing?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Sabay-sabay. Commercial housing din

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: po kasi ang socialized. Binebenta rin po yun. Kaya

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: more or less pareho po ang requirement. Kaya ang sinistreamline natin, apektado po, bareho yung socialized housing and

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: non

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: -socialized housing projects. Okay. Ang point, Madam Chair, yung socialized housing at saka yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: open market, medyo mas mababa yung margin para sa mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: developers dun sa socialized housing. Ang point, Madam Chair, hindi ba pwedeng mas streamlined pa, hindi siya kapareho

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: doon sa open market yung sa socialized housing? Pagkating

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: po sa socialized housing, Madam Chair, mayroon po tayong reference, yung BP220, yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: po ang reference ng socialized housing. Talaga

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: pong mas mababa yung technical requirements ng socialized housing compared to the open market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Madam Chair, another thing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Madam Chair, sa Jensen, may mga developers na may mga sentiments na yung mga processing nila sa payments nila aabot ng six

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: sila mag-process. Unlike before na Jensen lang, yung sentiments nila, pag yung developers nadidelay, may penalty, pero

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: doon sa kanila, sa part nila, wala raw. So may magagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: ba tayo para ma-improve yung offices natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: na nagpo-process ang mga payments para doon sa mga developers?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Part po yan ang ating digitalization and coordination with the land bank.

segments.text: Meron na po tayong mga online payments ngayon na pinapatupad sa departamento.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay. Thank you. Thank you, sir. Thank you, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: My first question goes to NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Although this was mentioned earlier already by Congresswoman Elago and Congresswoman Lani Mercado,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: last year, or for 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Ngayon, checking for 2027, wala tayong naka-allocate na EHAP fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu

segments.text: Actually, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai

segments.text: So, yun nga po, for 2027, zero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Pero did we request or

segments.text: is it only DBM ang naglalagay kung magkano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Okay. Madam Chair, this is precisely why we are asking this question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Kasi in my district, unfortunately, there are several instances talaga na maraming sunog

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: and ang IHOP yung nakakatulong na kahit pa paano makabangon yung mga nasunugan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: sa mga, hindi lang siguro sa aking distrito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So with a zero NEP for 2027, Madam Chair, baka we can discuss this with the Committee on Appropriation

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: na sana mabigyan ng tulong ang NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: With regards to the EHAP and the Quick Response Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: And then another question, Madam Chair, I understand na yung mga bago nating mga housing projects ngayon

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: naka-package na, meron ng mga covered courts, may mga daycare centers, may mga talipapan na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: However, we have old...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: resettlement projects na wala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: We are wondering, does NHA have budget for these old projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Can you please answer?

segments.text: Unfortunately, Madam Chair, wala po kaming fund for those things for our old projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: And maybe GM can provide us a summary of requested by the different districts with regards to facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: For example, in my district, we have about six or seven relocation sites.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: And all of them are requesting for daycare centers na hindi naman namin kayang punuan ang lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: At nag-iiba, nag-request din ng mga covered courts and other facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, baka I'm sure NHA is also receiving the same

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: requests.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Maybe the GM's office can provide or the NHA can provide us a list.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: And we can perhaps trace it up with the committee on appropriation, perhaps for additional budget for these old resettlement projects.

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: Madam Chair, due to the limited funding, we're prioritizing all our budget to housing units.

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: And we also have...

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: We prioritize the housing units more.

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: Yung mga [unclear], we're asking help from them.

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: and also the

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai
segments.text: LGU to construct the daycare centers, the covered courts, and the other [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Kasi hindi kasi lahat ng mga LGU may kapasidad po talagin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: May mga municipalities tayo na mga fourth class, fifth class municipalities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Although not in my district, may mga ganong resettlement na they don't have the capacity to provide such amenities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, baka kung makaka-allocate tayo ng additional funding to NHA, I'm sure that will help...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: these old resettlement sites.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Now, my last question goes to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: the DHSUD and Pag-IBIG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: First and foremost, I'd like to commend Secretary Aliling with regards to the 4PH program.

segments.text: Marami po talaga natutulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Now, I was looking at the allocation for the interest subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Tama po ba na ang allocation natin for this year is 1.1 billion?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Tama po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Yung 1.1 billion po na interest subsidy, para sa ilang bahay po ito, or ilang homeowners po?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Around 33,000, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: 33,000 housing units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: 33,000 housing units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Madam Chair, currently po, ilan po yung applications po na sa tingin po natin will be taken?

segments.text: Taken out by next year, either with Pag-ibig or with...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: I guess with only Pag-ibig, kasi Pag-ibig lang naman ng mechanism na may interest subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Ilan po yung expected natin matitake out next year?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Pag-ibig, ya CEO will answer, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Pag-IBIG Fund CEO Marilene C. Acosta
segments.text: Madam Chair, we expect to take out 15,000 units next year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, 15,000 units.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, yung inalocate po natin...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: I think 33,000 units is more than sufficient.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Or, ito po bang 1.1 ay meron po kasing na itinitake out this year, nakasama pa po doon?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Kasama po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Kaya po, 33,000. Tama po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, yun lang naman po yung actually yung question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: We just wanted to make sure that yung mga natake out po this year and yung in-expect po natin next year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: ay meron po yung sufficient allocation for the subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Because, malalaman...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Malaki po...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: Inaasahan po ito talaga ng ating mga constituents at mga, you know, the Filipino families working.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ivan Howard A. Guintu
segments.text: So, that's all, Madam Chair, and thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Hindi pa rin naiwasan, masira ang mga tahanan, lalo ng mga pamilyang walang kakayahan magpatayo na mas matibay at disaster-resilient na bahay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Kaya po, welcome the SUDE Integrated Disaster Shelter Assistance Program, or IDSAP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: which provides shelter assistance to families whose homes are damaged by the disaster.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: However, the Commission on Audit found that the processing and distribution of

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: emergency shelter support, a component of IDSAP, were delayed by 68 to 343 days,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: contrary to the objectives of the program of providing timely emergency shelter assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: May we ask the SUDE what caused this delay and what measures have been put in place to prevent them from recurring?

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Madam Chair, if I may reply.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: When I was appointed as Secretary, the IDSAP disbursement backlog was included in the backlog.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: But we have already disbursed the available funds that will be disbursed.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, the funds that we have not yet disbursed are the ones that are affected because the funds in the NHA have not yet been lowered.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, the cash that we have disbursed has already been fully disbursed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Kaya po, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Emergency assistance should arrive as soon as it is needed, not after a few months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: We hope the SUD can ensure that affected families receive shelter assistance promptly when disaster strikes.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Madam Chair, we have already arranged the system.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: The only problem we had recently was the availability of funds.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, once we receive the funds, do you expect that we will be able to distribute funds to those in need?

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Like us, in Katanduanes, you know that we are always on the move.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, sometimes it arrives, and sometimes the others, no matter what, make a plan so that it will be successful.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: That is our problem all the time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: And I hope that the SUD will...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: solve this problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Anyway, Madam Chair, I was supposed to raise this concern regarding student dormitories for the State University in our province

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: for the students who are coming from far away places.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we are also grateful to the other campuses, which will benefit students from the Northern Municipalities.

segments.text: Madam Chair, if I may, with regards to the dormitories for the State Universities,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: we have an existing program already. In fact,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: on how Pag-ibig can have a joint venture with these State Universities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, actually, last year, I heard from the general manager of the NHC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: so I would like to thank him, and that is why I am here today.
